vedic_reference.note: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘शर्वेश’ (sharvesh), which means ‘Lord of Shars’ or ‘The one who is the master of mountains and hills’. It is a popular name in Hindu mythology and is used to denote various deities, including Lord Shiva and Lord Vishnu.
